page.title: Plugins
page.description: Add a report or a notification channel to FixFlow without changing FixFlow itself.
page.note: A plugin is code that someone put on the server, and it runs with the server's rights: only switch on plugins from people you trust.
page.load_failed: The plugins could not be loaded.
page.empty_text: To add one, put its folder in the plugins folder on the server and restart FixFlow. The plugins guide explains how, and has two samples to copy.

failed.title: Some plugins did not load
failed.intro: FixFlow carried on without them. Fix or remove the folder on the server and restart.
